verdict.rationale: The Segment docs catalog page has built-in "Open in ChatGPT / Claude / Cursor / Perplexity" actions, a first-party way to hand documentation to an AI agent. The Public API also offers a downloadable OpenAPI specification that an agent could consume. However, there is no evidence of an llms.txt file, and a probe for a markdown version of the docs returned HTTP 404, so agent-oriented docs support looks thin. missing for 10: an llms.txt / llms-full.txt index, raw markdown docs endpoints (the probe 404'd), documentation describing the agent-oriented docs features, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
